description: This Java source file defines the class CommandResponseSenderImpl, which is an implementation of the CommandResponseSender interface. It provides functionality for sending command response messages over AMQP links, including methods for creating, sending messages, and handling AMQP link attributes in a messaging client context.

classes.name: CommandResponseSenderImpl
classes.description: An implementation class for sending command response messages over an AMQP link, with methods to create the sender, send messages, and manage AMQP link properties.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the delivery outcome, integrating tracing span.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint string for command response responses.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for its delivery outcome.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message with a specific span context and waits for the delivery outcome.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address string for command responses based on tenant ID and reply ID.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Creates an AMQP message from a CommandResponse object, sets its address, and sends it, returning a Future of ProtonDelivery.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a new CommandResponseSender instance with proper link configuration, including flow latency considerations.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a tracing span for forwarding command responses, with span kind set to CLIENT.
